subject: OrbitPay marketplace listing — logo, approved quote, and usage permission

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing: request for short quote and logo

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OrbitPay is excited about the integration. Our partnerships team is preparing the AWS Marketplace co-sell listing and asked if Redwood could provide:

- A short customer quote (1–2 sentences) we can use on the listing and in promotional materials
- High-res logo files (PNG and EPS preferable) and guidance on clearspace/color variations
- Confirmation that you’re okay with OrbitPay being listed as a reference customer and a one-line testimonial attributed to OrbitPay

Our target publish date is the week of Nov 22. Can you send assets and an approved quote by Nov 16 to keep us on schedule? If there’s a legal form we need signed, please flag it.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships | OrbitPay
ethan.cole@orbitpay.com

Hi Ethan — great to hear the timeline. We can absolutely support this. Below are two quote options (short and very short) — pick whichever you prefer or edit as needed:

1) Short (recommended): "OrbitPay reduced our cross-border payment latency and lowered per-transaction inference costs, enabling faster reconciliation across regions."
2) Very short: "OrbitPay helped us scale secure, low-latency payments globally."

We’ll also provide PNG and EPS logos. Please confirm you’re comfortable with attribution to OrbitPay and that the quotes can be used on AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace pages and co-marketing collateral.

Marissa (marketing) — looping you in for final wording and logo specs. Dev — can you make sure the staging listing has a placeholder so we can push the approved quote once we get it?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

Quick draft for approvals — feel free to tweak. Also note legal may want a simple permission line; I included a one-liner they can sign off on.

-- Suggested marketplace blurb (final will be edited for tone on AWS page) --
"We rely on Redwood Inference to deliver predictable, low-latency inference for payment validation at scale; their routing and caching reduced our token costs while improving throughput."

-- Short testimonial options --
A) "Redwood made our inference predictable and cost-effective across regions."
B) "Fast, reliable inference that scales with our transaction volume."

Legal-approved attribution language to request from OrbitPay: "OrbitPay hereby grants Redwood Inference permission to use the above quote(s) and OrbitPay logos in Redwood marketing materials and marketplace listings."

Dev: staging link when ready? I can push assets to the staging listing at the link Jasmine provided.

Thanks — Marissa
